test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 06 March 2023)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The science and art of growing vegetables, fruits and flowers
solution:
The correct answer is **2) Horticulture.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Horticulture **refers to** the science and art of growing fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants**. It includes plant propagation, cultivation, breeding, genetic engineering, and crop management.(फल, सब्जियां और सजावटी पौधे उगाने का विज्ञान और कला। इसमें पौधों का प्रसार, खेती, प्रजनन, जेनेटिक इंजीनियरिंग और फसल प्रबंधन शामिल हैं।)
 
• Horticulturists work in gardens, nurseries, greenhouses, research institutions, and academic institutions.
 
 
• *Example sentence: The **horticulture **department of the university is conducting research on developing new varieties of tomatoes that are resistant to pests and diseases.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options:
 
• **Herpetology**: The study of reptiles and amphibians(सरीसृप और उभयचरों का अध्ययन).
 
 
• Example sentence: The **herpetology **club organized a field trip to the national park to observe different species of snakes and frogs.
 
 
 
• **Haplology**: The linguistic phenomenon of omitting one of two identical or similar syllables in a word(एक शब्द में दो समान या समान शब्दांशों में से एक को छोड़ने की भाषाई घटना).
 
 
• Example sentence: The word "**probably**" is an example of haplology, as the two syllables "ob" are omitted in pronunciation.
 
 
 
• **Herbing**: This is not a recognized word in English.(यह अंग्रेजी का कोई शब्द नहीं है।)
